About this report

Marked by operator
Stretches of row (the bands on the map) where the operator marked gopher activity while pushing the cart.
Photos
None yet: the camera images from this visit haven’t been reviewed.
Locations
The row the cart was in, and the distance from the N end of each row. Approximate: the cart uses standard GPS, not survey-grade.
Leads, not proof
Each mark is a spot to check on the ground, not a confirmed gopher or active burrow.
Your data
You own the raw imagery from your farm. We keep a copy to train our detection models, unless you ask us to delete it after training.

Boxes show what the model found and the operator approved.
